room_rent.note: Base plan has no room rent cap. Optional 'Room Rent limit' add-on caps at 1% of SI or ₹5,000/day (whichever lower) and ICU at 2% of SI or ₹7,500/day.

icu.note: Base plan has no ICU cap. Optional 'Room Rent limit' add-on caps ICU at 2% of SI or ₹7,500/day (whichever lower).

copayment.note: Optional Co-Pay add-on allows insured to voluntarily opt 5%, 10% or 20% co-pay on every claim.

sub_limits.note: Base plan has no sub-limits. Optional 'Cataract Capping' add-on caps cataract at ₹25k–₹40k/eye. Optional 'Modern Surgeries limit' caps modern treatments at 50% of SI. Domiciliary capped at 10% of SI (inbuilt).

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting is 36 months or 24 months depending on plan chosen (E-Connect/Basic vs Elite/Supreme/Supreme Plus). Optional 'PED Protector' add-on (age ≤50) can reduce to 1–2 completed policy years with sub-limits.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 12-month list includes cataract, hernia, hydrocele, piles, sinusitis etc.; 24-month list includes calculus, joint replacement, prolapsed disc etc.; 36-month list includes obesity surgery, joint replacement (degenerative), spondylosis etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Code Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. No optional maternity add-on mentioned.

cumulative_bonus.note: Inbuilt Loyalty Perk: 10% of Basic SI per claim-free year, max 100%. Optional 'Super Booster' add-on increases rate to 50%/yr up to 150% of Basic SI.

restoration.note: Restored SI = 100% of Basic SI, triggered when Basic SI exhausted. Cannot be used for same illness/disease for which claim was paid in current year. Optional 'Reload of Sum Insured' add-on waives the unrelated-illness restriction.

pre_hosp.note: Policy wording states 'period as mentioned in the Schedule'; exact days not specified in the wording document.

post_hosp.note: Policy wording states 'period as mentioned in the Schedule'; exact days not specified in the wording document.

day_care.note: Extensive list of 140 named day-care procedures provided; also covers any procedure requiring <24 hrs due to technological advancement.

domiciliary.display: Covered up to 10% of Basic SI
domiciliary.note: Several conditions excluded from domiciliary cover (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, etc.).

ayush.display: Covered up to Basic SI (inpatient only)
ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient hospitalisation (min 24 hrs) covered up to Basic SI. OPD, day care, pre/post-hospitalisation AYUSH excluded.

organ_donor.note: Covers donor screening and harvesting expenses. Donor's pre/post-hospitalisation and post-harvesting treatment excluded.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered; maximum liability as specified in Schedule (exact amount not stated in wording).

modern_treatments.display: Optional add-on, up to 50% of SI
modern_treatments.note: Modern surgeries (robotic, stereotactic, HIFU, deep brain stimulation, oral chemo, immunotherapy, intravitreal injections, stem cell therapy etc.) covered only via optional 'Modern Surgeries limit' add-on at 50% of SI.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items in Annexure-A are excluded by default. Optional 'Zero Deduct Cover' waives these exclusions.

global_cover.note: Optional 'Global Cover' for emergency inpatient hospitalisation outside India; reimbursement in INR; max 180 consecutive days abroad; treatment must originate outside India.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim contestable except on grounds of fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/quarterly/half-yearly premium; 15 days for monthly instalment.

free_look.note: Applicable only for new individual policies; not on renewals or policies with tenure less than 1 year.

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: STDs/HIV, dental (non-accident), external congenital anomaly, OPD treatment, spectacles/hearing aids, external prosthetics/devices, alopecia/hair treatment

optional_riders.display: Zero Deduct Cover, Vector Borne Disease Benefit, Super Booster, EMI Protector, PED Protector, Global Cover, Domestic Travel Plus, Reload of SI, Co-Pay, Modern Surgeries, Room Rent Limit, Cataract Capping
